title: Cosmic Skull Portal
description: A massive skeletal skull with golden spiral teeth and curved horns dominates the foreground, its eye sockets glowing. Behind it floats a large circular cosmic portal with glowing purple rings covered in runes, containing layered surreal landscapes including a yellow dripping orb and a silhouetted forest inside smaller orbs.
prompt: A monumental skeletal skull with ornate golden spiral teeth and large curved horns floating in space, its eye sockets glowing with green light. Behind the skull is a giant circular cosmic portal made of glowing purple rings inscribed with runes and alchemical symbols, containing nested surreal orbs with dripping golden liquid, a silhouetted pine forest, and vibrant nebulae. Dark starry background with purple and teal cosmic clouds, highly detailed surreal fantasy style.
